description: Defines the 'beerocks::os_utils' class providing OS utility functions such as process path retrieval, file existence check, system calls, PID management, and OS info retrieval. Contains platform-specific macros and function declarations.

classes.name: os_utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for OS-related operations such as process info, file management, system calls, and OS identification.

methods.name: get_process_path
methods.description: Returns the current process executable path or an empty string if unavailable.

methods.name: get_process_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory of the current process executable.

methods.name: file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a specified file exists.

methods.name: system_call
methods.description: Executes a system command, optionally in detached mode.

methods.name: system_call_with_output
methods.description: Executes a system command and returns its output, including stderr if enabled.

methods.name: kill_pid
methods.description: Kills a process identified by PID read from a file.

methods.name: is_pid_running
methods.description: Checks if a process with a PID from a file is running.

methods.name: read_pid_file
methods.description: Reads a process ID from a specified file.

methods.name: write_pid_file
methods.description: Creates a PID file for a process.

methods.name: touch_pid_file
methods.description: Creates or updates a PID file.

methods.name: redirect_console_std
methods.description: Redirects console output to a log file.

methods.name: remove_residual_files
methods.description: Removes residual files from previous process instances.

methods.name: get_os_name
methods.description: Retrieves the operating system name and version.
